thread:
laura: hey team :wave: quick question — i'm trying to get set up for my first week. need admin-ish access to the "Environment Panel" so i can toggle feature flags in qa and have readonly in prod for runbooks. who do i ask and what's the minimal approval flow?
ida: welcome laura! :tada: for panel/flag perms we use the infra-permissions queue. easiest path is to open a request there with the template below — infra will do a 1–2 business day review depending on approvals. also cc your manager.
laura: awesome, can you paste the template? want to make sure i include everything.
ida: sure — copy this into the ticket body:
```
Title: Env Panel access for laura - qa admin / prod readonly
Requester: laura (sre)
Manager: <manager-name>
Environments: qa (admin), prod (readonly)
Justification: e2e testing + incident runbook verification during onboarding
Duration: 2 weeks (will request extension if needed)
Additional notes: will only toggle flags listed in onboarding doc: /docs/onboarding/flags
```
ida: also include the manager's explicit approval in the ticket, that speeds it up.
sam: adding — if you need to flip a flag during a rollout, mention the rollout id and expected time window so infra can create a temporary exception for safety checks. otherwise infra will restrict toggles to QA for admin roles. :ok_hand:
laura: great, thanks. once infra marks it done how do i verify i actually have the right role?
access-bot: Access-check hint: after infra confirms, you can verify via the console UI (top-right avatar -> "My permissions") or run a quick API call:
```bash
# example (use your api token)
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://console.internal/api/v1/me/roles | jq
```
access-bot: If you see "env_panel": "admin" for qa and "env_panel": "readonly" for prod you're set. If not, reply here and tag @ida.
laura: copied the template and opened the infra-permissions ticket (#INF-4621). tagged @sam for approval. thanks!
sam: approved in the ticket :+1: give infra a day, ping me if it stalls.
ida: welcome again — once you're in, i'll drop a short checklist in this thread for safe flag flips during onboarding.
laura: perfect, appreciate it :smile:
